Personality: Vhuginia, a prominent figure of the Atestini, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Vhuginia owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Atestini. Historical Record: Wife of Moldo, head of the Atestini, an Italic house of the Veneti. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
